relationship.purpose: repair teacher task validity at the first C67E invalid sigma before reopening any interface-complexity question

H: A single prospectively specified Gaussian-augmentation recipe can restore a task-valid teacher target at sigma=.36 without materially sacrificing clean validation accuracy.
T: On fresh model seeds 66400-66415, train paired clean-only and Gaussian-augmented teachers from the same initialization. The augmented teacher uses the same 60-epoch optimizer/permutation schedule as the clean teacher, but each training minibatch independently perturbs 50% of examples with clipped additive Gaussian sigma=.36. Evaluate both teachers on clean validation and on the same per-seed shifted validation tensor at sigma=.36.
D: Advance the augmented teacher as a valid target for a later separate interface experiment only if all three locked gates pass: augmented-clean minus clean-teacher-clean validation accuracy is non-inferior within -4 pp; augmented-shift minus clean-teacher-shift validation accuracy is superior with bootstrap95 lower bound > 0 pp; augmented-teacher shifted-minus-clean accuracy has bootstrap95 lower bound > -20 pp. Otherwise stop and report which repair gates failed.
C: Gaussian augmentation may improve shifted accuracy only by sacrificing too much clean accuracy.
The specified 50% fixed-sigma recipe may be too weak or too strong even if another augmentation schedule could work.
Teacher robustness failure may reflect model capacity or clipping-induced distribution changes rather than insufficient augmentation.
Restoring teacher task validity does not imply any particular P0/P2 interface result because robust training can change internal boundary geometry.
U: The -4 pp clean safeguard and -20 pp validity safeguard are preregistered experiment criteria, not universal quality constants.
This experiment tests one augmentation recipe at one target sigma and does not optimize augmentation hyperparameters.
A successful repair is exploratory evidence for target construction, not a confirmatory interface-complexity claim.

teacher_architecture.paired_initialization: clean-only and augmented teachers both instantiate Net(model_seed), so initial parameters are identical

augmentation_recipe.selection: for each training minibatch, draw independent Bernoulli(0.5) mask per example from the locked augmentation RNG; selected examples receive additive sigma=.36 iid Gaussian noise and are clipped to [0,1]

evaluation_shift.pairing: clean-only and augmented teachers within a model seed use exactly the same shifted validation tensor

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: both teacher trainings complete and all four required accuracies are finite

clean_accuracy_noninferiority.statistic: paired augmented-teacher clean validation accuracy minus clean-only-teacher clean validation accuracy
clean_accuracy_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -4.0 percentage points

shifted_accuracy_superiority.statistic: paired augmented-teacher shifted validation accuracy minus clean-only-teacher shifted validation accuracy at sigma=.36
shifted_accuracy_superiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.0 percentage points

augmented_teacher_task_validity.statistic: paired augmented-teacher shifted minus augmented-teacher clean validation accuracy
augmented_teacher_task_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -20.0 percentage points

bootstrap.method: paired model-seed percentile 95%; one common bootstrap index matrix reused across all three gates

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C68E paired clean-versus-augmented Residual-MLP teacher repair at sigma=.36
not_supported_even_if_advance: Gaussian augmentation universally repairs teacher robustness
P0 will remain sufficient for the repaired teacher
teacher correction is unnecessary under strong shift
